# `grounded_villages.config` — root

Every type with its summary and every non-private constructor, method and constant. The
signature is the contract; read the source only when the summary is not enough.

The one config file this mod writes (`docs/spec/contracts/data-contract.md` DATA-REQ-002): a pure Java model (grounded_villages.config.ConfigModel) and its parser/serialiser (grounded_villages.config.ConfigCodec), built on a small hand-rolled, dependency-free JSON reader (grounded_villages.config.ConfigJson) rather than a config library (`decisions/DEC-008-config-file.md`).

### `class ConfigBounds` — `src/main/java/grounded_villages/config/ConfigBounds.java`
The "sane range" bounds `docs/spec/domains/config.md` §"Validation rules" names by example ("a negative radius, a fraction outside 0-1") but does not enumerate key-by-key -- this class is that enumeration, one bound pair per numeric key in `docs/spec/domains/config.md` §3's schema table, plus the #clamp(int, int, int)/#clamp(double, double, double) helpers both ConfigModel (silent, defensive) and ConfigCodec (logged, per-key) clamp against -- one set of numbers, not two.
- `double FRACTION_MIN`
- `double FRACTION_MAX`
- `int SITE_MAX_HEIGHT_SPREAD_MIN` — No natural ceiling narrower than the build-height span; a generous, corruption-only guard.
- `int SITE_MAX_HEIGHT_SPREAD_MAX`
- `int SITE_SEARCH_RADIUS_MIN` — `domains/tiers.md` "Spacing": the 128-block hard engine ceiling bounds every block-radius key.
- `int SITE_SEARCH_RADIUS_MAX`
- `int SITE_SEARCH_STEP_MIN` — Must be positive -- a zero step never advances the search.
- `int SITE_SEARCH_STEP_MAX`
- `int SITE_SEARCH_ATTEMPTS_MIN`
- `int SITE_SEARCH_ATTEMPTS_MAX`
- `int PIECE_MAX_HEIGHT_DEVIATION_MIN`
- `int PIECE_MAX_HEIGHT_DEVIATION_MAX`
- `double TIER_WEIGHT_MIN` — A relative roll weight; no sane ceiling narrower than "very large", only non-negative.
- `double TIER_WEIGHT_MAX`
- `int TIER_JIGSAW_DEPTH_MIN` — Vanilla's own jigsaw depth is a small integer (`03-glossary.md` "jigsaw depth").
- `int TIER_JIGSAW_DEPTH_MAX`
- `int TIER_MAX_DISTANCE_MIN` — The 128-block hard engine ceiling, explicit in `domains/tiers.md` "Spacing".
- `int TIER_MAX_DISTANCE_MAX`
- `int TIER_HAMLET_MINIMUM_PIECES_MIN`
- `int TIER_HAMLET_MINIMUM_PIECES_MAX`
- `double TIER_PERFORMANCE_CAP_MULTIPLIER_MIN` — Must be positive to mean anything as a multiplier on vanilla's own piece count.
- `double TIER_PERFORMANCE_CAP_MULTIPLIER_MAX`
- `int clamp(int value, int min, int max)`
- `double clamp(double value, double min, double max)`

### `class ConfigCodec` — `src/main/java/grounded_villages/config/ConfigCodec.java`
Parses and serialises grounded_villages.json on top of ConfigJson (`docs/spec/domains/config.md` §"Validation rules").
- `ParseOutcome parse(String text)`
- `String serialize(ConfigModel config)` — The canonical on-disk shape, matching `domains/config.md` §3's proposed JSON exactly.

    - **nested** `record ParseOutcome(ConfigModel config, List<String> warnings, boolean malformed)`
    (`CONFIG-REQ-004`), empty when the file was entirely well-formed and in range file fell back to shipped defaults (CONFIG-FAIL-001); config is still ConfigDefaults#defaults() in that case

### `class ConfigHolder` — `src/main/java/grounded_villages/config/ConfigHolder.java`
The one place the mixin hook (`docs/spec/04-architecture.md` "Shape") and every pure-logic class reads the loaded config from.
- `ConfigModel get()` — The currently loaded config; never null.
- `void set(ConfigModel config)` — Called once, by each loader's own entrypoint, after ConfigIo#loadOrCreate returns.

### `class ConfigIo` — `src/main/java/grounded_villages/config/ConfigIo.java`
Reads grounded_villages.json from the game's config directory at server startup, writing the shipped defaults there the first time it is missing (`CONFIG-REQ-001`), and validating an existing file on every later run (`CONFIG-REQ-002`).
- `String FILE_NAME` — grounded_villages.json's own name inside the game's config directory.
- `ConfigModel loadOrCreate(Path configDir)` — missing, the parsed-and-validated file if it existed and was readable, or ConfigDefaults#defaults() in-memory alone if the file existed but could not be read, or was malformed and could not be replaced either

### `class ConfigJson` — `src/main/java/grounded_villages/config/ConfigJson.java`
A small hand-written, dependency-free JSON reader for grounded_villages.json's own fixed shape (`decisions/DEC-008-config-file.md`: "no config mechanism is both present and loader-neutral across this mod's six nodes" -- Fabric has no config API, NeoForge's own is TOML/NeoForge-only, so a hand-rolled parser is the only loader-neutral option, the same shape `villager_voices`' own dependency-free MiniJson already uses).
- `Object parse(String text)` — Parses text as one JSON value: a Map&lt;String, Object&gt; for an object (insertion-ordered), a List&lt;Object&gt; for an array, a String, a Double, a Boolean, or null.

    - **nested** `class JsonSyntaxException`
    Malformed JSON text, reported with the character offset ConfigJson noticed it at.
    - `JsonSyntaxException(String message)`

### `class ConfigMigrations` — `src/main/java/grounded_villages/config/ConfigMigrations.java`
The forward-only migration hook `docs/spec/contracts/data-contract.md` "Versioning" names: "a future key addition is forward-compatible ...
- `Map<String, Object> migrate(Map<String, Object> root, int fromVersion)` — case today, and the "no-op on current version" case a future migration must keep true) -- a newer file than this build understands is read forward-compatibly by ConfigCodec itself (an unrecognised key is ignored with a warning), not migrated backward here

### `record ConfigModel(int schemaVersion, Scope scope, Site site, Piece piece, Tier tier)` — `src/main/java/grounded_villages/config/ConfigModel.java`
The pure, loader-free config model (`docs/spec/04-architecture.md` ARCH-DEC-003): mirrors `docs/spec/domains/config.md` §3's schema table exactly, one nested record per JSON object in the schema.

    - **nested** `record Scope(List<String> structureTags)`
    scope.structure_tags (`decisions/DEC-007-village-tag-scope.md`).

    - **nested** `record Site(boolean enabled, int maxHeightSpread, double maxWaterFraction, int searchRadius, int searchStep, int searchAttempts)`
    site.* -- `domains/site.md`'s own thresholds and search bounds.

    - **nested** `record Piece(boolean enabled, int maxHeightDeviation)`
    piece.* -- `domains/pieces.md`'s per-piece tolerance.

    - **nested** `record Tier(boolean enabled, TierWeights weights, TierBudget jigsawDepth, TierBudget maxDistance, int hamletMinimumPieces, double performanceCapMultiplier)`
    tier.* -- `domains/tiers.md`'s weights, budgets and the performance cap.

    - **nested** `record TierWeights(double hamlet, double village, double town, double city)`
    tier.weights.

    - **nested** `record TierBudget(int hamlet, int village, int town, int city)`
    A per-tier integer budget: tier.jigsaw_depth.* (maxDepth fed to vanilla's jigsaw assembly) or tier.max_distance.* (max_distance_from_center), each clamped by its own caller since the two share this shape but not the same bounds.
